function.arguments:
{"command": "python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('mmlu_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

categories = list(data['categories'].keys())
models = data['models']

# Extract data for each model
model_data = {}
for model in models:
    model_data[model] = [data['categories'][cat][model] for cat in categories]

# Set up the plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))
x = np.arange(len(categories))
width = 0.2

# Define colors for each model
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#96CEB4']

# Create grouped bars
for i, model in enumerate(models):
    bars = ax.bar(x + i * width, model_data[model], width, 
                  label=model, color=colors[i], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
    # Add value labels on top of bars
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax.annotate(f'{height}%',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlabel('Subject Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Accuracy (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('MMLU Benchmark: Model Accuracy Across Subject Categories', 
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_xticks(x + width * 1.5)
ax.set_xticklabels(categories, fontsize=11)
ax.legend(title='Models', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper left')
ax.set_ylim(65, 95)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Add annotation about key findings
ax.annotate('GPT-4 & Claude-3 lead all categories',
            xy=(0.5, 0.95), xycoords='axes fraction',
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.8))

ax.annotate('LLaMA-3 has largest gap in STEM (11.1%)',
            xy=(0.5, 0.05), xycoords='axes fraction',
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='lightcoral', alpha=0.8))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('mmlu_comparison_chart.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', 
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to mmlu_comparison_chart.png")
EOF"}
